message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming dataframe, image files, or labels before they are consumed by the dataset and dataloaders.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from local filesystem paths with no checksum verification, signed URL, or authenticated remote-source handling visible in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels directly from the dataframe and uses them without any validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or noise-detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples; images are loaded and passed through augmentation pipelines without any integrity or poisoning checks.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses timm and torchvision to load pretrained models (via select_model utility), but no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions are visible anywhere in the provided code.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before or during training; the commented-out BalanceClassSampler is the closest thing but it is disabled and only resamples rather than validates.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation-clustering, gradient-anomaly, or any other backdoor/trigger detection mechanism is present in the training loop or dataset code.
No detected differential privacy: Neither Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, nor any DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While GroupKFold/StratifiedKFold splits are used, there is no held-out test set isolated from training, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no independent metric verification to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The dataset loading and inference path reads images directly via cv2.imread and passes them through transforms without any shape, range, or schema validation checks on the inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output probabilities for NaN values, out-of-range values, or applies any sanity bounds before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image classification model (Cassava leaf disease), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
